chapters.title: The change was simple, and it sounds boring, but it changed everything.
Here is the system, step by step, because the system is the whole point.
The numbers made me believe in this, because I track them every Sunday in a plain spreadsheet.
The second rule is that one idea gets one format, never two.
People ask me how long this takes, and I want to be honest about it.
The third rule is the hardest one, and I still break it sometimes.
If you take one thing from today, take this: your problem is probably not that you need more ideas.
